purpose: IDB-backed log of MLS Welcome join failures and decrypt failures. Appends FailedWelcomeRecord entries keyed by giftWrapEventId (upsert semantics for dedup), exposes load/forget/prune helpers, and dispatches notestr:failed-welcomes-changed on window after every mutation so UI components can refresh without polling.

public_api.name: appendFailedWelcome
public_api.description: Upserts a FailedWelcomeRecord into the notestr-failed-welcomes IDB store (keyed by giftWrapEventId), then dispatches notestr:failed-welcomes-changed on window.

public_api.name: loadFailedWelcomes
public_api.signature: async function loadFailedWelcomes(opts?: { since?: number; limit?: number }): Promise<FailedWelcomeRecord[]>
public_api.description: Returns all stored records, optionally filtered to recordedAt >= since, up to limit entries, sorted by recordedAt descending.

public_api.name: forgetFailedWelcome
public_api.description: Removes the record for the given giftWrapEventId from IDB, then dispatches notestr:failed-welcomes-changed on window.

public_api.name: pruneOlderThan
public_api.description: Removes all records with recordedAt < (Date.now() - ms), then dispatches notestr:failed-welcomes-changed on window.

public_api.name: FailedWelcomeRecord
public_api.signature: interface FailedWelcomeRecord { recordedAt: number; giftWrapEventId: string; innerKind: number; innerCreatedAt: number; inviterPubkey: string | null; groupId: string | null; kpRef: string | null; failureReason: string; failureDetail: string; }
public_api.description: Schema for a failed Welcome join or decrypt-failure event stored in IDB.

events_emitted: notestr:failed-welcomes-changed (CustomEvent on window, after every mutation)
